claim_boundary: Offline research only; no production writes, equipment control, safety certification, energy-yield claim, or independent validation. FORGE reanalysis is exploratory because the historical record was already examined. Standard moving averages are baselines, not proprietary LumenCore inventions.

ndbc.target: WVHT squared times APD, units m^2 s; activity proxy only, not electrical generation or calibrated wave power

timestamp_rules: Preserve original timeline; never remove rows before defining elapsed-time horizons
Exact timestamp target join; missing target is unscored and never imputed
Calibration target timestamp must be strictly before evaluation start
Use observed finite nonnegative target values only; no unrelated sensor filters
Moving averages require at least 80 percent of expected within-window observations
Zero-baseline-error comparisons fail closed rather than divide by zero

models.persistence: Most recent available valid observation; no learned parameters
models.rolling: Choose one elapsed-time moving-average window by lowest pooled calibration MAE; tie goes to shorter window; freeze window before evaluation
models.matured_error_gate: Use frozen rolling forecast only when the last seven fully matured calendar days contain at least five scored days, at least 80 percent of possible origin scores per day, pooled gain over persistence is at least five percent, and daily paired-error mean exceeds 1.96 times its standard error. Otherwise use persistence. A day's outcomes become eligible only after day-end plus forecast horizon; no use of partially matured outcomes. This is a heuristic fallback, not a safety guarantee.

scoring.primary: pooled MAE on common origin-target pairs
secondary: fraction of evaluated days worse than comparator
scoring.multiplicity: Holm correction over 63 predeclared comparisons; unavailable cases assigned p=1
scoring.replication_screen: At least 5 percent lower pooled MAE, positive pointwise interval lower bound, and Holm-adjusted centered-bootstrap p below 0.05. These are screening criteria, not guarantees; short/nonstationary records weaken uncertainty estimates.

audit: Count forward-filled target cells under previous protocol
Check previous validation/test and completed-block outcome availability
Retain failed acquisitions, negative results and code defects
